label: Every actual root gives by total optimal output over fixed candidates with a unique optimum
paraphrase: OPEN rival, analyst formulation, unattributed (the optimizing creator, being-level surrogate): for a fixed candidate set and a fixed partially ordered quality scale, every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w gives by total optimal output (OptimalOutputs on n's giving-output profile: at w and at every world accessible from w where n exists, n gives being to something, and every being it gives being is an optimal candidate), and at most one candidate is optimal. Rowe's argument that a perfectly good creator of the unique best must create it and so is not free (navigation, not attributed), with candidates read as beings given being, not complete worlds or orders of effects. It does not say why the root optimizes. With SS and a rational exercise toward a given being other than the root, it makes WN (0266eac2) fail (G3 law 3).
